In the instant case the documents made available on the record so far it relates to violation of the provisions of GST Act are not being relied upon by the prosecution to indicate any such violation under the provision of GST Act but what is contended is that some such documents are either fraudulent or it contains forged signature, resulting offence under sections 318(4)/336(3)/340(2)/303(2)/317(2)/317(5) of BNS with the specific allegation that the petitioners were involved in fraud and forgery as regards certain documents related to GST.
